title: lonicera japonica var. aureoreticulata
intro: Lonicera japonica var. aureoreticulata, commonly known as Gold and Purple Honeysuckle or Aureoreticulata Honeysuckle, is a deciduous climber in the Honeysuckle family, native to Japan and East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and calming the nervous system, making it a popular remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera japonica var. aureoreticulata include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including chlorogenic acid, luteolin, and isoleucoside, have been found to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to its health benefits.
